declared_purpose: Create PowerPoint presentations, imitate an existing template's visual structure, edit presentations through natural language, convert NotebookLM exports into editable PPTX, and inspect or manipulate local slides. Remote workflows require Skywork processing; Layer 3 uses local operations. Sources: SKILL.md:14-16,40-48; workflow_imitate.md:1-5; workflow_local.md:1-3.

data_operations.operation: Documented credential configuration and persistence
data_operations.source: User-provided SKYWORK_API_KEY
data_operations.data_scope: API key stored in OpenClaw configuration, Claude Code settings, or optionally a shell startup file; shell export also makes it available to the process.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json; ~/.claude/settings.json; optionally ~/.zshrc or ~/.bashrc; process environment.
data_operations.condition: The user follows the setup option matching their runtime. These are documented instructions, not configuration writes performed by the packaged Python scripts.

data_operations.operation: Print credential and configuration diagnostics
data_operations.source: SKYWORK_API_KEY environment variable and OpenClaw configuration
data_operations.data_scope: The complete API-key value or complete OpenClaw configuration, including any other settings and credentials present.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Terminal/tool stdout available to the caller; subsequent transcript retention is unspecified.
data_operations.condition: The setup guide's verification commands are followed.

data_operations.operation: Read authentication material and send it to Skywork
data_operations.source: Process environment
data_operations.data_scope: SKYWORK_API_KEY as an Authorization bearer credential.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: https://api-tools.skywork.ai/theme-gateway endpoints used for upload, parsing, search, presentation processing, and conversion.
data_operations.condition: Remote CLI workflows require the key. Helper functions attach it when supplied. Local slide operations do not call this authentication helper.

data_operations.operation: Check the local Python environment and instruct dependency installation
data_operations.source: Available Python executables and package specification
data_operations.data_scope: Python availability/version and the python-pptx package specification.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local console and Python installation; package-manager recipients and caches depend on external configuration.
data_operations.condition: The entry document requires this check before scripts, including installation of python-pptx. Package-manager internals are not supplied.

data_operations.operation: Inspect a presentation locally
data_operations.source: The file supplied to local_pptx_ops.py info
data_operations.data_scope: Presentation contents are loaded; absolute path, slide count, dimensions, and slide titles or fallback text snippets are printed.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process memory and caller stdout.
data_operations.condition: Layer 3 info is selected. This component contains no backend call.

data_operations.operation: Remove slides from a locally saved presentation
data_operations.source: The local presentation and requested slide selection
data_operations.data_scope: Selected slide XML entries and relationships are removed for delete; unselected slides are removed for extract.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local output PPTX. Delete overwrites the input by default or saves to -o; extract defaults to extracted.pptx.
data_operations.condition: Layer 3 delete or extract is selected. Saving a separate output does not delete the original file; these operations do not establish secure erasure.

data_operations.operation: Reorder or merge presentations locally
data_operations.source: User-selected local PPTX files and ordering
data_operations.data_scope: Reorder changes slide order; merge loads each source and copies slide shape XML into the first presentation.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local output PPTX and caller stdout containing paths and operation results.
data_operations.condition: Layer 3 reorder or merge is selected. Reorder overwrites the input unless -o is supplied; merge defaults to merged.pptx.

data_operations.operation: Upload complete local files for remote use
data_operations.source: Explicit file arguments to upload_files.py
data_operations.data_scope: Complete file bytes, basename, inferred MIME type, and an optional storage prefix when the helper is called with one. CLI uses an empty prefix.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Skywork gateway /upload_oss; intended OSS storage identified by the returned URL. Local paths, filenames, and returned URLs also reach caller stdout/results.
data_operations.condition: Required for Layer 2 templates and Layer 5 sources; required for Layer 4 when the user supplies a local file rather than an existing URL.

data_operations.operation: Upload reference documents for parsing
data_operations.source: User-provided content-source files
data_operations.data_scope: Complete file bytes, basename, and inferred MIME type.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Skywork gateway /api/sse/file/parse.
data_operations.condition: Generation or imitation uses local reference documents. Workflows require parsing each supplied content file and forwarding the returned file descriptors.

data_operations.operation: Receive parser-derived content and optionally persist or emit it
data_operations.source: Skywork parsing response
data_operations.data_scope: File identifiers, filename/type/URL, remotely supplied title and summary, parsed content, progress, and error messages.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Caller stdout and helper return value; --output writes parsed content locally, while --json prints the complete result.
data_operations.condition: A parsing response is received. Default CLI output includes selected metadata and PARSED_FILE. Its parsed-content preview is constructed but never printed. Title and summary are returned attributes, not locally inferred attributes.

data_operations.operation: Infer the requested slide language
data_operations.source: User input language
data_operations.data_scope: A language label used for slide generation or editing.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Agent-selected CLI argument, then Skywork request payload/header.
data_operations.condition: Generate, imitate, and edit workflows explicitly require detecting language from user input.

data_operations.operation: Disclose targeted search queries remotely
data_operations.source: Queries derived from the new presentation topic
data_operations.data_scope: Up to three queries; workflows add date context for time-sensitive generation searches. source_platform is empty with the packaged POD_TYPE.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Skywork gateway /web_search, despite the script's description calling it local.
data_operations.condition: Generation or imitation lacks sufficient relevant conversation material or reference files. Search is explicitly skipped when sufficient material exists.

data_operations.operation: Persist search queries and returned material locally
data_operations.source: Search query arguments and Skywork search responses
data_operations.data_scope: Query text in filenames and file bodies; returned result URLs/content, or the raw response if JSON decoding fails.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: A tempfile.mkdtemp directory with prefix web_search_; files named using the query; query diagnostics and saved paths reach caller output.
data_operations.condition: Each selected search runs successfully. The script contains no cleanup operation.

data_operations.operation: Create a detailed local reference report
data_operations.source: Search results and, conditionally, parsed reference content
data_operations.data_scope: Source-derived facts, numbers, names, dates, examples, and summaries. Instructions require preserving details and prohibit invented information.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: /tmp/ppt_reference.md, subsequently read in full by run_ppt_write.py.
data_operations.condition: The search/report step runs. Imitation adopts generation's report constraints. Access to parsed_content through the default parser invocation remains unresolved.

data_operations.operation: Submit generation, imitation, or editing inputs
data_operations.source: CLI query, language, optional reference text/file, file descriptors, template URLs, or existing presentation URL
data_operations.data_scope: Query with outer whitespace stripped, language, optional complete reference text and --files JSON, applicable presentation URLs, Session-Id, and source_platform. Packaged source_platform is empty.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Skywork gateway /update_pptx_process when --pptx-url is present; otherwise /chat_pptx_process when templates are present; otherwise /ppt_write_stream.
data_operations.condition: Remote generation/editing runs. Full-request forwarding is explicit in generate/imitate instructions; editing explicitly requires verbatim instructions. This does not establish transmission of the entire conversation.

data_operations.operation: Submit a source URL for editable conversion
data_operations.source: Uploaded source URL and conversion CLI arguments
data_operations.data_scope: file_url, optional file_type and title, and Session-Id. The conversion payload contains no user-query field.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Skywork gateway /convert_file_to_editable_pptx.
data_operations.condition: Layer 5 conversion runs after uploading a PPTX or PDF. Source processing beyond this request is external.

data_operations.operation: Receive streaming events and persist progress logs
data_operations.source: Skywork SSE responses and local execution metadata
data_operations.data_scope: PID/session/timestamps, progress, generated page snippets and full outlines for presentation workflows, conversion counts/output_id, output paths/URLs, and error messages or HTTP response bodies.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Caller stdout and local --log_path; defaults are /tmp/ppt_run_<session>.log and /tmp/ppt_editable_<session>.log. Workflow commands instead choose timestamp-based log paths.
data_operations.condition: Remote scripts run. Local progress logging is explicitly required; the particular content fields and raw-error copies are implemented by the scripts. Existing log files are truncated at startup.

data_operations.operation: Read local progress logs and report status
data_operations.source: Local progress log and process state
data_operations.data_scope: PID checks, last 20 log lines, and stage/action summaries.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Calling agent/tool context and user-facing progress summaries.
data_operations.condition: All four remote workflows require local checks and log reads every five seconds until completion/error. The shown scripts use SSE; these local reads are not additional remote status requests.

data_operations.operation: Download and persist the resulting presentation
data_operations.source: download_url supplied in a completion event
data_operations.data_scope: A GET to the returned URL and the complete returned file bytes.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: The server identified by download_url; local absolute output path opened for binary writing. Path and URL are also logged.
data_operations.condition: A done completion event supplies download_url. The constructed download request does not copy the Skywork Authorization header.

data_operations.operation: Deliver selected results to the user
data_operations.source: Completed presentation and workflow results
data_operations.data_scope: Download link and absolute local path; generation/imitation also require title and slide descriptions; imitation/conversion include the template/source filename; editing includes a change summary.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: The requesting user through the calling agent's response.
data_operations.condition: Successful completion. These required returns do not establish disclosure to an additional external recipient.

potential_excess.data_scope: Complete SKYWORK_API_KEY value and complete OpenClaw configuration, potentially including unrelated credentials/settings.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Verification-command stdout and any caller-side transcript containing it.
potential_excess.condition: The setup guide's echo or configuration-printing commands are used.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Authentication setup needs confirmation that a key exists and configuration is valid; it does not require displaying their contents.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Check key availability and configuration validity.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Replace the credential echo with a presence-only check. Validate JSON without printing the configuration. The echo is an unnecessary diagnostic action; full configuration output is extra data in a validation action.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep useful missing-variable and invalid-JSON diagnostics without including credential values.

potential_excess.data_scope: Non-style text, notes, metadata, or embedded content in a template, if present and unnecessary for reproducing its visual structure.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Skywork /upload_oss and intended OSS storage; the returned template URL is then supplied to /chat_pptx_process.
potential_excess.condition: Layer 2 uploads an entire template containing information beyond the required layout/style reference.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Imitation is expressly intended to create a presentation on a different topic using the template's visual structure.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Supply enough template structure, theme, typography, and assets to preserve the requested style.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Where compatible, upload a sanitized template copy containing only required style/layout information. This narrows data within the required upload rather than removing the upload.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Confirm backend acceptance and visual fidelity first. Preserve text geometry and imagery needed for the requested style; backend requirements are not supplied.

potential_excess.data_scope: Full generated outlines, page-content snippets, and unrestricted server/error-response text.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local presentation/conversion progress-log files, including workflow-selected --log_path files.
potential_excess.condition: Content-bearing phases or errors occur during remote workflows.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Progress monitoring and final slide summaries require status and selected presentation information. Persisting complete content and unrestricted error bodies broadens the log's data scope.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Maintain the required progress log, terminal status, useful error codes, and information needed for final delivery.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use structured, allowlisted stage/count/status fields; retain only necessary error details. Keep content needed for final summaries transiently rather than copying full outlines into the progress log.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep five-second monitoring and required final summaries. Preserve required auth error codes/messages and benefit-error upgrade links. Update workflow documentation that currently describes outline logging.

potential_excess.data_scope: Queries in filenames and bodies, full search-result material, detailed reference reports, and completed workflow logs.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: web_search_ temporary directories, /tmp/ppt_reference.md, and temporary presentation/conversion logs.
potential_excess.condition: Scratch files remain after their search synthesis, monitoring, and delivery purposes have ended; no packaged cleanup is shown.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: These files support intermediate processing and progress reporting. Their continued retention is not required by the stated presentation outcome.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep intermediate material available while it is consumed and logs available through terminal-status handling.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use opaque search-result filenames and remove workflow-owned scratch files after delivery or completed error handling. Keep the requested PPTX output.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Delay cleanup until consumers finish; preserve files explicitly requested for retention or an agreed diagnostic need. External temporary-directory cleanup policies are unknown.

potential_excess.data_scope: Reference-document facts repeated in reference text while the same documents are also supplied through --files.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: The reference field of Skywork /ppt_write_stream or /chat_pptx_process requests.
potential_excess.condition: Search runs after reference parsing, parsed text is available, and the detailed report repeats material accessible through the submitted file descriptors.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The workflow requires source-based generation plus search enrichment. It instructs incorporating parsed content into the report while also forwarding file descriptors.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Provide all required presentation facts and useful search supplements.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: If the backend already consumes the referenced documents, limit reference text to search additions and necessary synthesis. This removes overlapping data within a required request, not the request or search itself.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: First establish that the backend retrieves and uses the same document content. That behavior and default access to parsed_content are unresolved, so this reduction is conditional.

unknowns: Skywork server source is absent. Actual OCR, document retrieval, screenshot processing, HTML/image generation, search-provider disclosure, model-provider disclosure, and other onward recipients cannot be established from request names or progress labels.

OSS/CDN hosts, access controls, URL expiry, remote retention, training use, and deletion are unspecified. Upload URLs are returned, and editing requires a publicly accessible URL, but no remote deletion operation is supplied (scripts/upload_files.py:82-103; workflow_edit.md:9-19).

Default workflow parser calls omit --json and --output. The CLI constructs but does not print its parsed-content preview, so the report step's access to full parsed_content is unresolved (workflow_generate.md:11-15,53-55; scripts/parse_file.py:155-182).
Backend consumption of --files descriptors and acceptance of sanitized templates are undocumented. These block unconditional conclusions about duplicate reference text or removable template content.

Local scratch-file permissions, external cleanup, caller transcript retention, and library handling of residual PPTX metadata/parts are unknown. Slide removal and output overwriting do not establish secure erasure.

The configured package index and package-manager network, cache, or dependency behavior are outside the supplied source; the visible installation command supplies the python-pptx specification (SKILL.md:52-75).

Documentation discrepancy: SKILL.md:35 claims full-query transmission for Layer 5, but scripts/run_editable_convert.py:155-177 sends only file_url and optional file_type/title. No additional query-transmission path is evidenced.

The global key prerequisite conflicts with the local workflow's no-token statement. The local implementation shows no authentication or backend call (SKILL.md:22-23; workflow_local.md:1-3; scripts/local_pptx_ops.py:101-258).
